people.name: Miriam
people.line: Moses' sister, a prophetess who led women in worship.

translations.web: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.
translations.bsb: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on until she was brought in again.
translations.kjv: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought
translations.asv: And Miriam was shut up without the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
